title: It was quite simple
html_source:
Is it really simple at all, though?

About the whole second half of the chapter is devoted to either teachings during the retreat or Stephen reeling from said teachings. For Stephen to run through so much thought as he does through this chapter, it’s pretty apparent that it wasn’t simple at all for him.

The process of confession is rather simple, but it was Stephen coming to terms with his sins that made the process actually very difficult.

anchor.prefix: the footboard of the housedoor trail over the threshold as it opened to let him in, before he saw again the table in the kitchen set for supper he would have knelt and confessed.
